about: Pronunciation fixes for word audio (#38). Each fix respells a word for the TTS voice only; the word on screen never changes. 'from' is matched case-insensitively as a substring, after stress marks are stripped, longest first, in one pass. It also matches inside longer words (siųsti fixes išsiųsti), so use whole words or roots, never a bare letter pair. Editing this file takes effect on the next request (no restart) and regenerates the affected clips. See documentation/audio.md.

fixes.note: Leonas misreads it; should sound like «сюсти»
